e.title: **把精算映射接到一个风险评分 API 上**：英国司法部监狱与缓刑服务（HMPPS）的一套 **Kotlin/Spring Boot 风险评分服务**，README 只有 **3,656 字节**却把**先决条件写成一条能跑的命令****——**调 `risk-scores` 之前必须先往 Redis 里初始化罪名代码精算映射**；**同一步骤在生产是一条公开可读的 Kubernetes 定时任务**；**并明说两条本地运行路线哪条推荐****（**Docker「不推荐」／**IntelliJ「推荐」**）
e.title_en: Wiring actuarial mappings into a risk-scoring API: a Kotlin and Spring Boot risk-scoring service from the UK Ministry of Justice prison and probation service, whose 3,656-byte README states its prerequisite as a command you can actually run, shows the same step automated in production by a public Kubernetes CronJob, and takes a side on which local run route to use, marking the Docker route as not recommended and the IntelliJ route as recommended.
e.title_hk: **把精算映射接到一個風險評分 API 上**：英國司法部監獄與緩刑服務（HMPPS）的一套 **Kotlin/Spring Boot 風險評分服務**，README 只有 **3,656 位元組**卻把**先決條件寫成一條能跑的命令****——**呼叫 `risk-scores` 之前必須先往 Redis 裡初始化罪名代碼精算映射**；**同一步驟在生產是一條公開可讀的 Kubernetes 定時任務**；**並明說兩條本機運行路線哪條推薦****（**Docker「不推薦」／**IntelliJ「推薦」**）
e.summary: **arns-risk-actuarial-api**（仓库 `ministryofjustice/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api`）**是英国司法部（Ministry of Justice）监狱与缓刑服务 HMPPS 的一套精算风险评分 API**（Kotlin／Spring Boot，**许可 MIT**，**实测 ★1**、**3,897 KB**、**创建 2025-07-04**、**推送 2026-09-07**）。**它在本轮主题里的价值不在算法，而在「接线」被写得多清楚**：**⭐⭐⭐ ①** `risk-scores` 这个端点**依赖另一份状态**（Redis 里的罪名代码精算映射），**README 把这件事写成一条可直接复制的命令**（**逐字**：**先**「**you must first initialise the offence-code actuarial mappings in Redis**」、**再**「**call the `/admin/update-offence-mapping` endpoint (no authentication required)**」）；**而同一动作在生产就是** `helm_deploy` 下的 **Kubernetes CronJob** `get-offence-actuarial-mapping`（**每天 07:00**，用 `alpine/curl` 发一条 POST）**——**那个「无需认证」的设计决定**正是**让集群内一条裸 curl 能成立的前提**；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **它把「已铺好」与「已通电」分开写**：`helm_deploy` 下 dev／preprod／prod 三个 values 都在、CI 也对三个环境都跑 helm lint，**但 `deploy_preprod` 与 `deploy_prod` 两个 job 在 `pipeline.yml` 里是被注释掉的**，**实际部署只有 dev 一条通路**；**⭐⭐ ③** **它对自己测试里的硬编码陷阱点名**（**逐字**「**you will need to change the hardcoded service URL in the test file**」）；**⭐⭐ ④** **覆盖率是一个数字加一条查缺口的命令**（**逐字**「**We do impose a minimum test coverage of 85%**」＋ `./gradlew koverHtmlReport`）；**⭐⭐ ⑤** **三枚徽章都接在可核查的外部对象上**（**本次实测**：**合规徽章地址本身返回 JSON 且当前为「**MoJ Compliant**」／**「**Pass**」**、**GHCR 镜像地址 200**、**dev 环境的 Swagger UI 返回 403**）。**⚠️ 本次未运行该服务任何一步、未读任何 Kotlin 源码**，故**不主张**任何端点按所述工作，**也不对其评分口径与公平性作任何评价**；**⚠️ ARNS 这个缩写本词条未能展开**（**不猜**）。
e.summary_hk: **arns-risk-actuarial-api**（倉庫 `ministryofjustice/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api`）**是英國司法部（Ministry of Justice）監獄與緩刑服務 HMPPS 的一套精算風險評分 API**（Kotlin／Spring Boot，**許可 MIT**，**實測 ★1**、**3,897 KB**、**建立 2025-07-04**、**推送 2026-09-07**）。**它在本輪主題裡的價值不在演算法，而在「接線」被寫得多清楚**：**⭐⭐⭐ ①** `risk-scores` 這個端點**依賴另一份狀態**（Redis 裡的罪名代碼精算映射），**README 把這件事寫成一條可直接複製的命令**（**逐字**：**先**「**you must first initialise the offence-code actuarial mappings in Redis**」、**再**「**call the `/admin/update-offence-mapping` endpoint (no authentication required)**」）；**而同一動作在生產就是** `helm_deploy` 下的 **Kubernetes CronJob** `get-offence-actuarial-mapping`（**每天 07:00**，用 `alpine/curl` 發一條 POST）**——**那個「無需認證」的設計決定**正是**讓叢集內一條裸 curl 能成立的前提**；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **它把「已鋪好」與「已通電」分開寫**：`helm_deploy` 下 dev／preprod／prod 三個 values 都在、CI 也對三個環境都跑 helm lint，**但 `deploy_preprod` 與 `deploy_prod` 兩個 job 在 `pipeline.yml` 裡是被註解掉的**，**實際部署只有 dev 一條通路**；**⭐⭐ ③** **它對自己測試裡的硬編碼陷阱點名**（**逐字**「**you will need to change the hardcoded service URL in the test file**」）；**⭐⭐ ④** **覆蓋率是一個數字加一條查缺口的命令**（**逐字**「**We do impose a minimum test coverage of 85%**」＋ `./gradlew koverHtmlReport`）；**⭐⭐ ⑤** **三枚徽章都接在可核查的外部對象上**（**本次實測**：**合規徽章地址本身回傳 JSON 且目前為「**MoJ Compliant**」／**「**Pass**」**、**GHCR 映像地址 200**、**dev 環境的 Swagger UI 回傳 403**）。**⚠️ 本次未運行該服務任何一步、未讀任何 Kotlin 原始碼**，故**不主張**任何端點按所述工作，**也不對其評分口徑與公平性作任何評價**；**⚠️ ARNS 這個縮寫本詞條未能展開**（**不猜**）。
e.summary_en: **arns-risk-actuarial-api** (repository `ministryofjustice/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api`) **is an actuarial risk-scoring API from HMPPS, the prison and probation service of the UK Ministry of Justice** (Kotlin and Spring Boot, **licence MIT**, **measured 1 star**, **3,897 KB**, **created 2025-07-04**, **pushed 2026-09-07**). **Its value for this round is not the algorithm but how clearly the wiring is written down**: **1, top** the `risk-scores` endpoint **depends on a separate piece of state**, the offence-code actuarial mappings held in Redis, and **the README states this as a command you can copy**, verbatim: first, that you must first initialise the offence-code actuarial mappings in Redis, and then that you call the `/admin/update-offence-mapping` endpoint, which the README itself marks as requiring no authentication; **in production that same action is a Kubernetes CronJob** named `get-offence-actuarial-mapping` under `helm_deploy`, running daily at 07:00 and issuing one POST with `alpine/curl`, **so the no-authentication design decision is exactly what lets a bare in-cluster curl work**. **2, top** **it separates what is provisioned from what is live**: values files for dev, preprod and prod all exist and CI lints all three, **yet the `deploy_preprod` and `deploy_prod` jobs are commented out in `pipeline.yml`, so only the dev path actually deploys**. **3** **it names the hardcoded trap in its own tests**, verbatim: you will need to change the hardcoded service URL in the test file. **4** **coverage is one number plus one command to find the gap**, verbatim: We do impose a minimum test coverage of 85%, with `./gradlew koverHtmlReport`. **5** **all three badges point at checkable external objects**: measured this round, the compliance badge endpoint returns JSON and currently reads MoJ Compliant and Pass, the GHCR image URL answers 200, and the dev Swagger UI answers 403. **Not run at all this round and no Kotlin source read**, so this entry does not claim any endpoint works as described **and makes no judgement on its scoring methodology or fairness**; **the acronym ARNS is left unexpanded rather than guessed**.
e.body:
**arns-risk-actuarial-api**（仓库 `ministryofjustice/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api`）**是英国司法部（Ministry of Justice）监狱与缓刑服务 HMPPS 旗下的一套精算风险评分 API**，**语言 Kotlin**、**构建 Spring Boot／Gradle**、**许可 MIT**、**实测 ★1**、**fork 0**、**仓库体量 3,897 KB**、**创建 2025-07-04**、**最后推送 2026-09-07**、**默认分支 `main`**（**均 GitHub API 实测**；**推送在解冻窗口之内，创建在窗口之外**）。**README 实测 3,656 字节**；**仓库经 GitHub API tree 接口实测共 372 条条目（未截断），其中 290 个文件、82 个目录**。本条目属于本轮主题**「接线：把它接到另一套东西上能用为止」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里「接线文档」写得最省字的一篇**：**它不说自己多强，只说**先做什么、**少了会怎样、**哪些值是环境相关的**。

**可核实信息（均 README、tree 与 raw 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「先决条件」写成一条能跑的命令，而不是一句要求**——**逐字**：**「**Before calling the `risk-scores` endpoint, you must first initialise the offence-code actuarial mappings in Redis.**」**，**紧接着**「**To do this, call the `/admin/update-offence-mapping` endpoint (no authentication required).**」**，**并给出可复制的**「**curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/update-offence-mapping**」**（**小节标题本身就是** `Initialising Offence-Code Actuarial Mappings`**）。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它承认了自己有两个状态**（服务进程 + Redis 里的映射），**并把这个先后顺序摆在正文最前面**——**多数 README 会把它塞进「注意事项」或干脆不写，读者会看到 `risk-scores` 返回空结果而不知为何**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 同一个手工步骤在生产里有一条公开可读的自动化对应物**——`helm_deploy/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api/templates/cron.yaml`（**实测 578 字节**）是一个 **Kubernetes CronJob**：`metadata.name` 为 `get-offence-actuarial-mapping`、`spec.schedule` 为 `0 7 * * *`（**每天 07:00**）、**容器** `name: curl`、**镜像** `image: alpine/curl`、**命令**为 `/bin/sh -c` 执行 `curl -v -f -X POST http://hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api/admin/update-offence-mapping`、`restartPolicy: Never`、`concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`、`securityContext.runAsUser: 1000`。**⭐ 四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ README 里那一步「手动初始化」与生产里这条定时任务是同一件事**——**读者因此能看出**「本地要手动做的那件事，线上不会忘」**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 那个「**no authentication required**」不是随手写的**：**它正是**让集群内一条**裸 curl**（**而且 URL 写的是 `http://` 而不是 `https://`**）**能成立的前提**——**认证决定、手工步骤、定时任务三样东西是同一根线上的接头**；**③ ⭐⭐ `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` 说明它想过重复执行**（**不让两次初始化重叠**）；**④ ⭐⭐ 以 `runAsUser: 1000` 明写非 root**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它把「已铺好」与「已通电」分开写**：`helm_deploy/` 下 **同时存在** `values-dev.yaml`、`values-preprod.yaml`、`values-prod.yaml`，`.github/workflows/pipeline.yml`（**实测 3,616 字节**）的 `helm_lint` job **用 matrix 对 dev／preprod／prod 三个环境都跑 lint**——**但 `build` 之后只接了 `deploy_dev`，紧随其后的 `deploy_preprod`（注释写 **Deploy to pre-production environment**）与 `deploy_prod`（注释写 **Deploy to production environment**）两个 job 整段是被 `#` 前置注释掉的**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮第二条最值得抄的写法**：**它没有把「支持三个环境」写成能力，而是让读者一眼看到**三个模板都在、三个都被 lint、**而只有 dev 通着电**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它点出自己测试脚本里的硬编码陷阱**——**逐字**：**「**If you wish to run the k6 performance tests against a different env you will need to change the hardcoded service URL in the test file.**」**，**且前一段先给出用环境变量的正规形式**「**k6 run -e AUTH_URL=http://localhost:8090/auth/oauth/token -e CLIENT_ID=REPLACE_ME -e CLIENT_SECRET=REPLACE_ME ./k6/performance-test.js**」**并提醒**「**Replace CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET with their actual values!**」**（**⭐ 即**它没有把「可换环境」讲成能力，**而是把「换环境要改哪一行」讲成已知限制**）。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 覆盖率是一个数字加一条查缺口的命令**——**逐字**：**「**We do impose a minimum test coverage of **85%**.**」**，**并给出**「**To generate a report to identify missing coverage, please run: `./gradlew koverHtmlReport`**」**（**⭐ 即**门槛与查缺口的手段成对出现，**而不是只写一个百分比**）。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三枚徽章都接在可核查的外部对象上**（**本次实测**）：**① 政府 repo-standards 合规徽章**——**它的徽章地址本身就是一个 API**，**返回**「**{"color":"005ea5","label":"MoJ Compliant","labelColor":"0b0c0c","message":"Pass","schemaVersion":1,"style":"for-the-badge"}**」**（**即当前为** Pass**）**；**② GHCR 容器镜像** `https://ghcr.io/ministryofjustice/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api` **返回 200**；**③ Swagger API 文档徽章指向 dev 主机** `https://arns-risk-actuarial-api-dev.hmpps.service.justice.gov.uk/swagger-ui/index.html`，**本次实测返回 403**。**⭐ 即**徽章不是装饰图，**而是接在报告、镜像与在线文档三个外部对象上的指针**——**同时它也暴露了一个常见错觉**：**「**API docs**」这枚徽章看着像公开文档，**实际指向的 dev 主机本次并不对外可读**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ CI 并发里留了一句诚实的因果说明**：`concurrency.group` 写作 `${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref == ‘refs/heads/main’ && github.sha || github.ref }}`、`cancel-in-progress` 为 `${{ github.ref != ‘refs/heads/main’ }}`，**而配置文件里逐字写着理由**：「**Note that two pipelines running within a few minutes of each other will cause issues with helm deploying to a namespace, as the second one will not be able to get a lock as a deploy will be in progress.**」**（**⭐ 即**把「为什么这样写」留在配置旁边，**而不是留在某人的记忆里**；**本次逐字引用 YAML 表达式时把原文的 ASCII 直引号写作弓形引号以维持本词条的引号约定，表达式内容未改**）。**⭐ ⑧ 安全扫描是分开的、可数的工作流**：`.github/workflows/` 实测共 7 条，**其中 5 条是安全类**（`security_codeql_actions_scan.yml`、`security_owasp.yml`、`security_snyk_scan.yml`、`security_veracode_pipeline_scan.yml`、`security_veracode_policy_scan.yml`），**另两条是** `pipeline.yml` 与 `deploy_to_env.yml`。**⭐ ⑨ 应用配置本身就是一张接线图**：`src/main/resources/application.yml`（**实测 1,760 字节**）写明 **JWT 用** `jwk-set-uri: ${hmpps-auth.url}/.well-known/jwks.json` **验签**、**注册了一个下游客户端** `manage-offences-api`（`authorization-grant-type: client_credentials`、**token 端点** `${hmpps-auth.url}/oauth/token`）、**Redis `ssl.enabled: true`**、`server.forward-headers-strategy: native` **并给出 tomcat `remoteip` 的**内部代理 CIDR 清单（10/8、192.168/16、169.254/16、127/8、172.16–172.31、::1 等）**以便在反向代理后取到真实客户端 IP**、**`shutdown: graceful`**、**actuator 只暴露** `info, health`（`include: ‘info, health’`）**且健康检查缓存 2000ms、`show-components` 与 `show-details` 都开、`probes.enabled: true`**、**`springdoc.swagger-ui.version` 钉在 `5.32.11`**、**Jackson 日期格式** `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`、**`spring.http.codecs.max-in-memory-size: 10MB`**。**⭐ ⑩ 本地栈是可读的，并且承认其中一块是替身**：`docker-compose.yml`（**实测 1,530 字节**）里那个名为 `manage-offences-api` 的服务**用的镜像其实是** `rodolpheche/wiremock`，**把仓库内** `./wiremock-manage-offences-api` **挂到** `/home/wiremock`、**以** `-verbose -global-response-templating` **启动**——**即下游在本地是个桩**；**Redis 用** `redis:8-alpine` **且** `ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=yes`；**三个服务各自的 healthcheck 都是** `bash -c echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/8080`；**HMPPS Auth 挂** `./auth_db` **卷并用 Flyway 位置清单**（**含** `filesystem:/auth_db`），**另把** `APPLICATION_AUTHENTICATION_UI_ALLOWLIST` **设为** `0.0.0.0/0`。**⭐ 即**「本地能跑」不等于「下游真的在那儿」，**它把替身留在明处**。**⭐ ⑪ 部署模板本身不在这个仓库里**：`helm_deploy/README.md`（**实测仅 203 字节**）逐字说 **「**This helm deployment makes use of the generic-service chart**」**并指向外部** `ministryofjustice/hmpps-helm-charts` 的 `charts/generic-service`（**本次实测该 Chart.yaml 返回 200，其 `version` 为 `3.17.5`**）——**⭐ 即**这个仓库只留 values，**接线接到一套组织级共享 chart 上**。**⭐ ⑫ 开发凭据是公开写出来的，用途也写明了**：README 里的 Basic 头 `aG1wcHMtYXJucy1yaXNrLWFjdHVhcmlhbC1hcGktZGV2OnRlc3Qtc2VjcmV0` **本次解码为** `hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api-dev:test-secret`，**Postman 授权设置也逐条列出**（OAuth 2.0／**Client Credentials**／**Token URL** `http://localhost:8090/auth/oauth/token`／**Client ID** `hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api-dev`／**Secret** `test-secret`／**Send as Basic Auth header**）——**这是一对本地 HMPPS Auth 容器里的开发凭据，不是生产秘密**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insurance-governance]]**（**保险治理**）、**[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]**（**监管机构对 AI 风险控制的要求**）**与 [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]]**（**持续监控**）**可并读**——**它给的是一个受监管环境里「评分服务长什么样」的工程样本**；**其公共部门个案评分场景与 [[insurance-fairness]] 讨论的公平性议题相邻，但本词条未作任何对照**；**而「先决条件必须先接线」的写法与 [[underwriting-decision-safety]] 的决策安全主题属同一类顾虑**。

**arns-risk-actuarial-api** (repository `ministryofjustice/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api`) **is an actuarial risk-scoring API belonging to HMPPS, the prison and probation service of the UK Ministry of Justice**, written in **Kotlin** and built on **Spring Boot and Gradle**, **licence MIT**, **measured 1 star**, **0 forks**, **3,897 KB**, **created 2025-07-04**, **last pushed 2026-09-07**, **default branch `main`** (all GitHub API measurements; **the push is inside the thaw window, the creation is outside it**). **The README measures 3,656 bytes**; **the repository measures 372 entries through the GitHub API tree endpoint, untruncated, being 290 files and 82 directories**. This entry belongs to this round theme, **wiring something up until another system can use it**; **this entry considers it the most economical piece of wiring documentation of the round four**: **it does not say how strong it is, only what to do first, what breaks if you skip that, and which values depend on the environment**.

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the tree endpoint and raw fetches**: **1, top: it states its prerequisite as a command you can run rather than as a request** — verbatim, that before calling the `risk-scores` endpoint you must first initialise the offence-code actuarial mappings in Redis, followed by the instruction to call the `/admin/update-offence-mapping` endpoint, which the README itself marks as requiring no authentication, with the copyable line `curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/update-offence-mapping`; the section heading is itself `Initialising Offence-Code Actuarial Mappings`. **This entry considers this the single most copyable thing of the round**: **it admits that it has two states**, the service process and the mappings held in Redis, **and puts that ordering at the very front of the document**, where most READMEs would bury it under caveats or omit it so that a reader sees `risk-scores` return empty results without knowing why. **2, top: the same manual step has a publicly readable automation counterpart in production** — `helm_deploy/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api/templates/cron.yaml`, measured at 578 bytes, is a **Kubernetes CronJob** named `get-offence-actuarial-mapping` whose `spec.schedule` is `0 7 * * *`, daily at 07:00, whose single container is named `curl`, uses the image `alpine/curl`, and runs `/bin/sh -c` with `curl -v -f -X POST http://hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api/admin/update-offence-mapping`, with `restartPolicy: Never`, `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` and `securityContext.runAsUser: 1000`. **Two things worth recording**: first, **the step the README has you do by hand and this production CronJob are the same action**, so a reader can see that what is manual locally will not be forgotten online; second, **the no-authentication line is not incidental** — it is exactly what lets a bare in-cluster curl work, and the URL it calls is plain `http://`, so the authentication decision, the manual step and the scheduled job are connectors on one wire. **3: it separates what is provisioned from what is live** — `helm_deploy/` carries `values-dev.yaml`, `values-preprod.yaml` and `values-prod.yaml` side by side, and the `helm_lint` job in `.github/workflows/pipeline.yml`, measured at 3,616 bytes, lints all three environments through a matrix, **yet after `build` only `deploy_dev` is connected: the `deploy_preprod` and `deploy_prod` jobs, commented as the pre-production and production deployment jobs, are commented out with leading `#` characters**. So all three templates exist, all three are linted, and only dev has power running through it. **4: it names the hardcoded trap in its own tests** — verbatim, that if you wish to run the k6 performance tests against a different env you will need to change the hardcoded service URL in the test file, preceded by the proper environment-variable form of the k6 command and the reminder to replace CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET with their actual values; **rather than presenting environment-portability as a feature, it presents the exact line you must edit for another environment as a known limitation**. **5: coverage is one number plus one command to find the gap** — verbatim, that a minimum test coverage of **85%** is imposed, with the instruction to run `./gradlew koverHtmlReport` to generate a report identifying missing coverage. **6: all three badges point at checkable external objects**, as measured this round: **the repo-standards compliance badge endpoint is itself an API returning `{"color":"005ea5","label":"MoJ Compliant","labelColor":"0b0c0c","message":"Pass","schemaVersion":1,"style":"for-the-badge"}`, currently reading Pass**; **the GHCR image URL `https://ghcr.io/ministryofjustice/hmpps-arns-risk-actuarial-api` answers 200**; **and the Swagger API docs badge points at the dev host `https://arns-risk-actuarial-api-dev.hmpps.service.justice.gov.uk/swagger-ui/index.html`, which answered 403 this round**. So a badge is not decoration but a pointer wired to a report, an image and live documentation, **and it also exposes a common illusion: a badge labelled API docs looks like public documentation while the dev host behind it was not publicly readable this round**. **7: the CI concurrency block keeps an honest causal note next to the configuration**, verbatim: that two pipelines running within a few minutes of each other will cause issues with helm deploying to a namespace, as the second one will not be able to get a lock as a deploy will be in progress; the group expression uses the commit SHA on main and cancels in progress elsewhere. **This round the ASCII quotation marks of the original YAML expressions were rendered as curved quotation marks to keep this entry quote convention, with the expressions themselves unchanged.** **8: the security scans are separate, countable workflows** — `.github/workflows/` holds seven, five of them security-related: a CodeQL actions scan, OWASP, Snyk, a Veracode pipeline scan and a Veracode policy scan, alongside `pipeline.yml` and `deploy_to_env.yml`. **9: the application configuration is itself a wiring diagram** — `src/main/resources/application.yml`, measured at 1,760 bytes, verifies JWTs against `${hmpps-auth.url}/.well-known/jwks.json`, registers a downstream client named `manage-offences-api` with `authorization-grant-type: client_credentials` and a token endpoint at `${hmpps-auth.url}/oauth/token`, enables Redis SSL, sets `server.forward-headers-strategy: native` with an explicit tomcat `remoteip` list of internal proxy ranges so the real client address survives a reverse proxy, enables graceful shutdown, exposes only `info` and `health` on actuator with a 2000 ms health cache, `show-components` and `show-details` both on and probes enabled, pins `springdoc.swagger-ui.version` at `5.32.11`, sets the Jackson date format and allows ten megabytes in memory per codec. **10: the local stack is readable, and admits that one piece of it is a stand-in** — in `docker-compose.yml`, measured at 1,530 bytes, the service named `manage-offences-api` actually runs the image `rodolpheche/wiremock`, mounting the in-repo `wiremock-manage-offences-api` directory at `/home/wiremock` and starting with `-verbose -global-response-templating`, so the downstream dependency is a stub locally; Redis is `redis:8-alpine` with empty passwords allowed; each healthcheck is a bash probe of the TCP port; and HMPPS Auth mounts an `auth_db` volume with a Flyway locations list. **Being runnable locally does not mean the downstream service is really there, and it keeps the stand-in in plain sight.** **11: the deployment templates are not in this repository** — `helm_deploy/README.md`, measured at only 203 bytes, says verbatim that this helm deployment makes use of the generic-service chart and points to `charts/generic-service` in the external `ministryofjustice/hmpps-helm-charts` repository, whose `Chart.yaml` answered 200 with `version` `3.17.5` this round;
